summary: Diodes Incorporated filed an 8-K reporting a $375 million private offering of 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2031, including full exercise of the initial purchasers' $50 million option. The notes are unsecured, non-interest-bearing, and mature August 15, 2031. Proceeds fund capped call transactions and a share repurchase, per the filing. The company also amended its credit agreement to extend maturity to August 12, 2031 and permit the new debt. The notes were issued under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust. Watch for conversion premium, dilution offset via capped calls, and share repurchase execution.
